verdict: Local search drove all activity this period; paid channels remain off.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Google Business Profile was the sole source of engagement — delivering 29 actions including 2 calls, 16 direction requests, and 11 website clicks, with a 150% surge mid-week before softening in the final few days. Paid advertising on Meta and Google carried zero spend and zero leads this period, so the entire picture is organic. Search clicks and site sessions both pulled back roughly 40% in the most recent 7 days, which is consistent with the GBP momentum easing after a spike on September 1st. We're monitoring the organic visibility trend closely and are addressing the gap in website conversion tracking so that visitor activity is counted accurately going forward. Next period, expect clearer conversion data from the site and a more complete picture of where interested visitors are dropping off.
